name: the Ram
archetype: the one who goes first and does not look back
failure_mode: cannot sit still long enough to be told the plan
calendar_note: the Diadem keeps the Venerated's feast here: born at the lambing, hence the title

name: the Bull
archetype: the one who will not be moved

name: the Twins
archetype: the one who argues both sides
virtue: sees the case against their own position
failure_mode: will not commit while a better argument exists

name: the Crab
archetype: the one who guards the house
failure_mode: the loyalty is to people, not to the cause, and it shows

name: the Lion
archetype: the one who must be seen
virtue: leads from in front because being watched steadies them

name: the Maiden
archetype: the one who keeps the record
virtue: notices the discrepancy nobody else did
failure_mode: corrects people who did not ask

name: the Scales
virtue: the fairest arbiter in the room

name: the Scorpion
archetype: the one who does not forget
virtue: carries the grudge that keeps everyone honest
failure_mode: carries it long after it stopped being useful

name: the Archer
archetype: the one who goes further out
virtue: the scout who comes back with the thing you needed
failure_mode: says the true thing at the worst moment

name: the Goat
virtue: will do the unglamorous work for years
failure_mode: measures people by what they have built

name: the Vessel
failure_mode: belongs to everyone and therefore to nobody

name: the Fishes
archetype: the one who dissolves the boundary
virtue: understands the enemy too well to hate them
failure_mode: understands the enemy too well to fight them
